name: sawn timber
definition: timber sawn to section for building and joinery, sold by length (species, `strength_class`, `treatment_class`, kiln-dried and regularised are attributes).

name: plywood
definition: board of thin wood veneers glued in cross-grained layers.

name: building board
definition: manufactured sheet for building (chipboard, MDF, OSB, plasterboard, cement board), sold loose.

name: decking board
definition: profiled timber or composite board sold loose for building a deck (K-66).

name: steel section
definition: steel bar, angle, channel, box or tube section sold by length for building and fabrication.

name: aluminium section
definition: aluminium bar, angle, channel or tube section sold by length.

name: cement
definition: powdered binder mixed with water and aggregate to make concrete or mortar (ready-mix bags included).

name: concrete block
definition: moulded block of concrete for building walls.

name: brick
definition: fired clay or concrete unit laid in mortar to build walls.

name: aggregate
definition: sand, gravel or ballast sold for concrete, mortar or sub-base (K-174).

name: paving slab
definition: flat slab of concrete or stone laid as a path, patio or drive surface.

name: sett
definition: small dressed block of stone or concrete laid as paving.

name: lawn edging
definition: strip or border of metal, plastic, timber or stone set along a lawn or bed edge.

name: weed membrane
definition: permeable sheet laid under paving, gravel or mulch to suppress weeds.

name: roofing sheet
definition: corrugated or profiled sheet of metal, bitumen, fibre cement or plastic laid as a roof or cladding.

name: insulation
definition: roll, slab or board of thermal or acoustic insulating material for a building (acoustic panels included).

name: flue pipe
definition: pipe that carries smoke and gases from a stove, boiler or fire to the outside.

name: chimney liner
definition: flexible or rigid liner fitted inside a chimney.

name: chimney pot
definition: pot or terminal set on top of a chimney stack.

name: door
definition: door leaf or door set for a building opening, installed or not.

name: window
definition: window frame and glazing unit for a building opening, installed or not.

name: fence panel
definition: prefabricated panel of timber, metal or composite fixed between posts.

name: gate
definition: hinged or sliding barrier for an opening in a fence or wall.

name: fence post
definition: post set in the ground to carry fence panels, rails or wire.

name: fence wire
definition: plain, barbed or high-tensile wire sold for fencing.

name: stock netting
definition: woven or welded wire mesh sold for fencing animals in or out.

name: electric-fence energiser
definition: unit that sends pulses of current along an electric fence (follows the fence under S3).

name: electric-fence tape
definition: conductive tape, rope or polywire strung as an electric fence.

name: electric-fence insulator
definition: insulator that holds an electric-fence wire or tape on a post.

name: wallpaper
definition: paper, vinyl or textile wall covering sold in rolls for hanging.

name: plaster
definition: powdered plaster or skim coat mixed with water to finish walls and ceilings.

name: wall tile
definition: tile made and rated for walls.

name: floor tile
definition: tile made and rated for floors (wear and slip rating on the object).

name: laminate flooring
definition: click-together boards with a printed decorative layer on a fibreboard core.

name: skirting and architrave
definition: moulded board that trims the base of a wall or the frame of a door or window.

name: wood screw
definition: tapered, coarse-threaded screw for fixing into timber and boards.

name: decking screw
definition: corrosion-resistant screw made to fix decking boards to joists.

name: drywall screw
definition: fine- or coarse-threaded bugle-head screw for fixing plasterboard to studs.

name: masonry/concrete screw
definition: hardened screw that cuts its own thread into a drilled hole in masonry or concrete.

name: self-drilling screw
definition: screw with a drill point that drills and taps sheet metal in one pass.

name: machine screw
definition: parallel-threaded screw for a tapped hole or a nut.

name: nail
definition: plain steel pin with a head, driven by hammer or nail gun (loose or collated).

name: concrete nail
definition: hardened nail made to be driven into concrete or masonry.

name: staple
definition: U-shaped wire fastener driven by a stapler or tacker.

name: bolt
definition: externally threaded fastener with a head, used with a nut (`property_class` an attribute).

name: nut
definition: internally threaded fastener that mates with a bolt or stud.

name: washer
definition: flat or spring ring set under a nut or head to spread load or lock it.

name: rivet
definition: fastener set by deforming its tail, including blind (pop) rivets.

name: wall plug
definition: plastic or fibre sleeve that expands in a drilled hole to hold a screw.

name: cavity fixing
definition: fixing that opens or grips behind a hollow wall or board.

name: chemical anchor
definition: resin cartridge or capsule that bonds a stud or bar into a drilled hole (resin sold alone is this kind).

name: frame fixing
definition: long plug and screw that fix a frame through to masonry in one pass.

name: steel anchor
definition: metal expansion anchor or anchor bolt for heavy fixings in concrete or masonry.

name: timber connector
definition: pressed-steel plate, hanger or bracket that joins timber members.

name: post support
definition: metal shoe, spike or base that holds a post in the ground or on a surface.

name: dowel (dowel pin)
definition: wooden, plastic or metal pin set into holes to join or align two parts.

name: packer (shim)
definition: thin plate or wedge set under or behind a frame or fixing to level or space it.

name: door hinge
definition: hinge on which a door, gate or window leaf swings (butt and other patterns are named forms).

name: cabinet knob or pull
definition: knob or pull handle fitted to a cabinet door or drawer (K-196).

name: door handle
definition: lever, knob or pull handle set for a door, without a lock (a lockset with a lock is B8).

name: latch
definition: catch that holds a door or gate shut without a key.

name: door bolt
definition: sliding bolt that secures a door or gate from one side.

name: hasp
definition: hinged slotted plate and staple that take a padlock.

name: bracket
definition: general bracket or shelf support fixed to a wall or structure (not one made for one screen or speaker).

name: letter plate
definition: letter flap and plate fitted in a door (K-188).

name: regulatory and safety sign
definition: sign that gives a safety, fire, hazard or legal instruction (K-192).

name: compression fitting
definition: fitting that seals on a pipe by a nut squeezing an olive.

name: push-fit fitting
definition: fitting that grips and seals a pipe pushed into it, with no tools or heat.

name: solder-ring fitting
definition: copper fitting with an integral ring of solder, sealed by heating.

name: end-feed fitting
definition: copper fitting sealed by solder fed into the joint while heated.

name: press-fit fitting
definition: fitting sealed by crimping onto the pipe with a press tool.

name: pipe
definition: plumbing, heating, gas or water supply pipe of copper, plastic or steel, sold by length or coil.

name: pipe clip
definition: clip or bracket that holds a pipe to a wall or joist.

name: tap
definition: hand-operated valve that delivers water at a basin, sink, bath or outside (mixer taps included; K-186).

name: valve
definition: valve that shuts off or controls flow in a pipe (stop cock, isolating and radiator valves).

name: waste fitting
definition: pipe and fitting for the waste outlet of a basin, sink or bath.

name: trap
definition: water-sealed bend under an outlet that blocks drain gases.

name: guttering
definition: gutter and downpipe sections and fittings that carry rainwater from a roof.

name: shower tray
definition: base set under a shower that collects water to its waste (K-186).

name: shower enclosure
definition: glass or panel walls and door around a shower.

name: bath panel
definition: panel that covers the side or end of a bath.

name: cable
definition: fixed-wiring mains cable (twin and earth and the like).

name: flex
definition: flexible mains cord for connecting appliances and fittings.

name: armoured cable
definition: mains cable with a steel-wire armour layer for burial or exposed runs.

name: cable clip
definition: clip that fixes a cable to a wall or surface.

name: switch
definition: wall switch for a mains circuit or light.

name: socket-outlet
definition: wall socket that takes mains plugs (types A to O are named forms).

name: mains plug
definition: rewireable or moulded plug for a mains flex (types A to O are named forms).

name: fuse
definition: cartridge or rewireable fuse that breaks a circuit on overload.

name: ceiling rose
definition: ceiling fitting where a pendant flex joins the fixed wiring (B-18).

name: extension lead
definition: flex with a mains plug and one or more sockets, on a reel or not.

name: consumer unit
definition: fuse box or board that holds a building's breakers or fuses.

name: wall and ceiling paint
definition: interior paint for walls and ceilings (emulsion is a binder, not a kind).

name: masonry paint
definition: exterior paint for brick, render and masonry.

name: fence paint
definition: paint or treatment for timber fences and sheds.

name: floor paint
definition: hard-wearing paint for concrete, wood or garage floors.

name: radiator paint
definition: heat-resistant paint for radiators and pipes.

name: tile paint
definition: paint made to adhere to glazed tiles.

name: furniture paint
definition: paint made for furniture and cabinets.

name: woodwork and metal paint (trim paint)
definition: gloss, satin or eggshell paint for doors, trim and metalwork (gloss and satinwood are `gloss_level` values).

name: spray paint
definition: paint in an aerosol can.

name: primer
definition: primer or undercoat, the preparatory coat under a top coat (`coat_role` primer, undercoat, primer-undercoat, sealer).

name: stain
definition: coloured finish that soaks into wood and shows its grain.

name: varnish
definition: clear or tinted film-forming finish for wood.

name: wood oil
definition: penetrating oil finish for wood (decking and furniture oils).

name: wax
definition: wax finish rubbed into wood.

name: sandpaper
definition: abrasive sheet or roll for hand or general use, not cut for one sander (K-12).

name: grab adhesive
definition: high-tack construction adhesive from a cartridge that holds on contact.

name: general adhesive or glue
definition: general-purpose glue for household and building repairs.

name: wood glue
definition: adhesive made to bond wood (PVA and others).

name: wallpaper adhesive
definition: paste for hanging wallpaper.

name: tile adhesive
definition: adhesive for fixing wall and floor tiles (C-12).

name: sealant (caulk)
definition: flexible compound that seals joints and gaps against water and air.

name: tile grout
definition: compound that fills the joints between tiles (C-12).

name: AA cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R6 (aliases LR6, UM-3, Mignon, penlight).

name: AAA cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R03.

name: C cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R14.

name: D cell
definition: cylindrical cell of IEC size R20.

name: CR123A cell
definition: 3 V primary lithium cylindrical cell used in lights and cameras.

name: 18650 cell
definition: lithium-ion cylindrical cell 18 mm by 65 mm, sold loose.

name: 21700 cell
definition: lithium-ion cylindrical cell 21 mm by 70 mm, sold loose.

name: coin cell
definition: flat button or coin cell (designations such as CR2032 are named forms).

name: 9 V battery
definition: rectangular 9 V battery with snap terminals (IEC 6F22 and kin).

name: sealed lead-acid block
definition: general sealed lead-acid battery block sold loose (6 V, 12 V).

name: battery charger for standard-size cells
definition: charger for loose standard cells such as AA, AAA and 18650 (K-3).

name: LPG cylinder
definition: refillable propane or butane bottle, owned or leased (`gas` and `valve` attributes; K-30).

name: gas canister
definition: small disposable gas canister for stoves, torches and lighters (K-30, K-166).

name: firewood logs
definition: split logs sold for burning (kiln-dried an attribute).

name: kindling
definition: small dry sticks for starting a fire.

name: coal
definition: coal or manufactured smokeless fuel sold in bags.

name: charcoal briquettes
definition: moulded briquettes of compressed charcoal for barbecues.

name: lump charcoal
definition: natural lumpwood charcoal (binchotan included).

name: wood pellets
definition: compressed wood pellets for pellet grills, stoves and boilers.

name: smoking chips and chunks
definition: wood chips or chunks for smoking food, by wood species.

name: lubricant
definition: general oil, grease or penetrating lubricant sold in a can or tube.

name: lighter fluid
definition: liquid fuel for refilling lighters or lighting barbecues.

name: fuel can
definition: container made to carry and store fuel.

name: firelighter
definition: block, cube or bag of fuel made to start a fire.

name: match
definition: safety or strike-anywhere match.

name: long utility lighter
definition: long-nozzle lighter for barbecues, stoves and fires (pocket lighters are B9).

name: candle lighter
definition: long lighter made to light candles.

name: lighter flint
definition: replacement flint for a lighter (K-166).

name: parcel tape
definition: wide adhesive tape for sealing parcels and boxes.

name: bubble wrap
definition: plastic sheet of air bubbles for cushioning goods.

name: stretch film
definition: clinging plastic film wound round goods or pallets.

name: void fill
definition: loose fill, paper or air pillows packed round goods in a box.

name: packing box
definition: cardboard box sold flat for packing or moving (boxes made for storing things are B1).
